capabilities: Renders book notes as a browsable 3D shelf
Filters books by reading status and genre
Adds books via Open Library search
Writes reading status to note properties
Opens book notes with cover and linked notes
disambiguation: Not an e-book reader; it displays notes that already exist in the vault as a 3D shelf.
extras: Desktop only for now. Covers are cached in the plugin folder so the shelf works offline; no account, no tracking.
problem: Obsidian has no visual overview of a reading list: book notes are flat text with no shelf-like browsing or reading status at a glance.

relations.evidence: Livres connects to Open Library (openlibrary.org and covers.openlibrary.org) to search for books

summary: 3D bookshelf that turns book notes in your vault into browsable To read, Reading and Read shelves, with Open Library lookup for adding books.
